review_candidates.title: Senior Manager, Corporate Security - Europe
review_candidates.description: POSITION SNAPSHOT JobReq ID: 55474 Type of work: Hybrid Type of contract: Open-ended/permanent Full/Part Time: Full time Salary Range: Location: Zaventem, BE About Us Bridgestone Americas, Inc. (BSAM), headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, and Bridgestone Europe, Middle East and Africa (BSEMEA), headquartered in Brussels, Belgium, operate collectively as a “Bridgestone West” strategic region. This region services the strategic business needs of teams across the Americas, Europe, Middle East and Africa. BSAM and BSEMEA are subsidiaries of Bridgestone Corporation, globally headquartered in Japan. Bridgestone and its subsidiaries develop, manufacture and market a wide range of Bridgestone, Firestone and associate brand products and solutions to address the needs of a broad range of customers and industries. About The Role Job Purpose The Senior Manager, Corporate Security Europe is responsible for overseeing all corporate security operations across Europe. This new role will help ensure the protection of employees, assets, and operations while helping enable business continuity and growth in diverse and complex risk environments. The position requires strategic leadership, strong regional risk awareness, and close collaboration with business leaders, HR, Legal, Compliance, IT, and external partners to proactively manage security risks and respond to security incidents. In line with Corporate Security programs and governance, this position will be responsible for building the Corporate Security foundations across Europe, working closely with regional, business, and functional leadership. Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive regional corporate security strategy aligned with global security objectives. Serve as the primary security advisor for the company in Europe. Oversee implementation of executive protection, event security, threat management physical and travel security. Build relationships with authorities, embassies, and emergency services. Deliver and enforce security standards, procedures, and training programs. Conduct and oversee security risk assessments. Monitor geopolitical, terrorism, crime, and emerging risks. Develop mitigation strategies and standards tailored to risks. Lead regional incident response and crisis management activities. Partner with Legal, Compliance, and HR on investigations and sensitive matters. Ensure reporting, compliance, KPIs, and continuous improvement. Qualifications & Experience Required Education, Master, other certification: Bachelor’s Degree in Security Management, Criminal Justice, International Relations or a related field. Experience (years): 10+ years of progressive experience in a corporate security department with regional or international responsibilities. Proven regional expertise managing security operations across Europe. Technical Skills: Knowledge of security standards, threat assessment, incident reporting, crisis management, and workplace violence. Knowledge of supply chain security programs such as AEO. Languages Skills: English fluency is required. Additional language skills aligned with the EMEA Footprint Soft/Behavioral Skills: Excellent communication skills and ability to summarize information. Strong business acumen and stakeholder collaboration. Track record of driving security initiatives across cross-functional projects. High integrity, ethical standards, and discretion. What We Offer At Bridgestone, what really matter is to foster co-creation opportunities and empowering you to be creative and curious to make mobility safer, more efficient, and more sustainable for future generations. Whatever role you fill, when you represent Bridgestone, you are a valued teammate, and part of our larger mission to “Serve Society with Superior Quality”, for that, we offer you more than just a competitive payment; we will provide you: A supportive and engaging onboarding experience to ensure a smooth transition into our team. The opportunity to develop and grow, through training and regular mentorship. Corporate Social Responsibility activities. A truly global, dynamic and challenging work environment. Agility and work/life effectiveness and your long-term well-being. A diverse and inclusive team. We are committed to create an even more inclusive culture that advances equity, embraces individuality, and helps our increasingly diverse teammates, customers, and communities thrive, by providing equal opportunities in employment. This means that all job applicants and members of staff will receive equal treatment and that we will not discriminate on grounds of gender, marital status, race, ethnicity, color, nationality, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, religion or age. ➜ Explore Our Career Site

review_candidates.description: Job Description Simulator Support Engineer - Major ICT and Defence System Integrator Permanent position Sydney based position - Eastern Suburbs naval base Active NV1 security clearance required - applicants without this cannot be considered Kinexus is a specialist defence and national security recruitment agency with over 25 years of working and specialising in the industry. We have partnered with a major ICT and defence system integration business who are actively deliverin a key training and simulation capability to the Royal Australian Navy, they are looking to expand the team with the addition of a permanent Simulator Support Engineer. The Simulator Support Engineer will provide technical support and engineering services to software, hardware and ICT systems relating to defence training simulators. In this role, you will be involved in the development, integration and support of complex simulation systems, including on-site support for uniformed Navy personnel. In This Role You Will Diagnose and resolve faults across simulator software applications, control hardware, visual/audio systems, and networked ICT infrastructure to minimise training downtime. Carry out preventative maintenance, software patching, configuration changes, and hardware servicing in line with maintenance schedules and vendor/manufacturer requirements. Manage servers, networks, workstations, and data links underpinning simulator operation, ensuring connectivity, cybersecurity compliance, and system availability. Deliver on-call and on-site technical assistance to instructors and operators, resolving issues in real time to keep training scenarios running. Maintain technical records, fault logs, and configuration documentation, and escalate unresolved issues to engineering or vendor support teams as required. What's Needed From You Degree or diploma in electrical/mechatronics/software engineering or computer science, plus relevant certifications across ICT (RHCSA/RHCE, CCNA/CCNP, etc), equivalent experience will also be considered. System administration skills across Linux server environments, including server build, configuration and management. Hardware and integration systems troubleshooting across simulator control, visual and audio hardware. Programming skills with low-level programming languages. Sound interesting? Want to find out more? Apply with your most up-to-date CV and we will be in touch with all relevant applicants. All applications should include your resume as a word document. (eTMF setup, periodic reviews, following up on missing documents, Safety Reports Dissemination), and assure that all eTMF documents are complete and verified for quality.
